Everyone claims the top 3%.
We show you the test.

Most talent platforms ask you to trust a badge. A percentage, a promise, a curated shortlist — and no way to check any of it.

BesTal publishes the test instead. Every engineer's profile shows what was tested, how they scored on five separate areas, who tested them, and when — including the reservations.

You don't have to believe our standard. You can read it.

See how we test →
Time zone

They work your hours.
Not “some overlap.”

Every BesTal engineer is assigned to one US time zone and works a full business day in it — Eastern, Central, Mountain or Pacific.

No 6am standups for them. No 9pm handoffs for you. No hunting for three usable hours in the middle of the day.

Browse by time zone

One zone, full day

9:00am to 6:00pm in your zone, every working day. Standups, pairing, code review and incidents — all inside normal hours.

Committed in writing

The working day is confirmed before the profile goes live, and reconfirmed regularly. If it lapses, the profile says so.

Filter by your zone

Only see engineers already working the hours your team works. Eastern, Central, Mountain or Pacific.

Four steps. No sourcing cycle.

1

Tell us what you need

One sentence is enough: "Two senior Snowflake engineers on Central hours, starting this week."

2

See the evidence

Matched engineers arrive with test results, verification status, hourly rate, time zone and start date already attached.

3

Try them free for 20 hours

Real work, your systems, your team. No charge, and no obligation to continue.

4

Keep them, or don't

Continue into a paid engagement, swap for someone else, or walk away. You keep the work either way.

The questions we built this platform to answer

Every one of these is answerable on a profile, without a call.

  • Who can start today, and in which discipline?
  • Do they work my team's hours — a full day, not a few?
  • What can this engineer actually do, and who says so?
  • Who tested them, and what did they get wrong?
  • Is their identity verified? Their employment history?
  • What is the hourly rate?
  • Can I see them work before I pay anything?
